name: Injection classifier
note: Screens untrusted content for injected instructions
summary: A dedicated classifier checks web pages and tool outputs for instructions aimed at the agent, and blocks content or actions that look driven by them. It is one layer among several: confirmations and scoped permissions cover what it misses.
how: Untrusted content (pages, tool outputs) is passed to the classifier
The classifier flags text that tries to instruct the agent
Flagged content is blocked, or the action it would drive is stopped
Other layers, such as user confirmations, catch what slips through
facts: Perplexity Comet (ML classifiers), Gemini in Chrome (runs alongside the planner)
Catches known attack styles; indirect and multilingual attacks are harder
goodFor: Browser agents reading arbitrary web pages
Agents that process email or other outside content
watchOut: Adds latency and cost to every page or tool result
